For a long time neither of you moves. The oil lamps flicker. The hall is quiet except for the sound of your breathing and hers — yours fast and shallow, hers deep and steady. She holds you against her body, her heartbeat a low, slow drum against your ear.
Her hand moves slowly through your hair. Her whiskers brush across your forehead. She murmurs something low — not words, or not words you know. A sound meant for no one but you.

name: Nautinto
text: "Stay a while longer. There is no hurry."

You close your eyes. Her body is warm and impossibly solid around you. The vibration in her chest settles into a steady, low hum that spreads through your bones. Your limbs go heavy. The world narrows to the sound of her heartbeat and the rise and fall of her breathing.
When you open your eyes again, the lamps have burned lower. You are still in her arms. She is still awake, watching the far wall with her vast, dark eyes. She notices you stir.

name: Nautinto
text: "There you are. You slept well."
She presses her muzzle gently against the top of your head. A kiss, or the closest thing to one.

name: Nautinto
text: "I had forgotten. How quiet it is, with someone here."

name: Nautinto
text: "Come back to me, little one. Whenever you need to."

name: Nautinto
text: You dress slowly. A smear of dried fluid catches on the inside of your thigh — you wipe it away without thinking. Nautinto watches you with quiet attention, making no move to rush. She pulls her crimson wraps back on with practiced ease, the geometric sigils settling into their familiar patterns.

name: Nautinto
text: "The hall is always open to you. You know that now."
You step back out through the opening into the dry air.
